questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A baseball player contracted with the local orchestra to perform for $5,000 at a children's concert. Shortly before the concert, the baseball player became embroiled in a highly publicized controversy over whether he had cursed and assaulted a baseball fan. The orchestra canceled the contract out of concern that attendance might be adversely affected by the baseball player's appearance.
The baseball player sued the orchestra for breach of contract. His business agent testified without contradiction that the cancellation had resulted in the baseball player not getting other contracts for performances and endorsements.
The trial court instructed the jury, in part, as follows: "If you find for the plaintiff, you may award damages for losses which at the time of contracting could reasonably have been foreseen by the defendant as a probable result of its breach. However, the law does not permit recovery for the loss of prospective profits of a new business caused by breach of contract."
On the baseball player's appeal from a jury verdict for the baseball player awarding damages only for the $5,000 fee promised by the orchestra, what will be the likely result?

choices.A: Affirmed, because the issue of damages for breach of contract was solely a jury question.
choices.B: Affirmed, because the trial court stated the law correctly.
choices.C: Reversed, because the test for limiting damages is what the breaching party could reasonably have foreseen at the time of the breach.
choices.D: Reversed, because under the prevailing modern view, lost profits of a new business are recoverable if they are established with reasonable certainty.

questions.zh-question:
一名棒球运动员与当地管弦乐团签订合同，在儿童音乐会上表演，报酬为5000美元。音乐会前不久，该棒球运动员卷入了一场广为人知的争议，涉及他是否咒骂并殴打了一名棒球迷。管弦乐团出于担心棒球运动员的出现可能会对上座率产生不利影响，取消了合同。

该棒球运动员以违约为由起诉了管弦乐团。他的商业经纪人作证且无人反驳，称合同的取消导致该棒球运动员未能获得其他表演和代言合同。

审判法院对陪审团的部分指示如下：“如果你们裁定原告胜诉，你们可以就损失判给损害赔偿金，这些损失在订立合同时可由被告合理预见到，作为其违约的可能结果。然而，法律不允许就因违约造成的新业务的预期利润损失获得赔偿。”

针对陪审团仅判给棒球运动员管弦乐团承诺的5000美元费用的裁决，棒球运动员提起上诉，可能的结果是什么？

zh-choices.A: 维持原判，因为违约损害赔偿问题完全是陪审团的问题。
zh-choices.B: 维持原判，因为审判法院正确地陈述了法律。
zh-choices.C: 推翻原判，因为限制损害赔偿的检验标准是违约方在违约时可以合理预见到的情况。
zh-choices.D: 推翻原判，因为根据通行的现代观点，如果新业务的利润损失能以合理的确定性得到证实，则是可以获得赔偿的。

questions.zh-explanation:
Contracts Remedies

MBE 考点解析：新业务的利润损失

正确答案：D

推翻原判，因为根据通行的现代观点，如果新业务的利润损失能以合理的确定性 (Reasonable Certainty) 得到证实，则是可以获得赔偿的。

1. 核心考点：新业务规则 (The New Business Rule)

本题的核心在于法院是否应该仅仅因为原告从事的是“新业务”或“新尝试”，就自动禁止其获得预期利润损失 (Lost Profits) 的赔偿。

传统观点 (Old View) 现代观点 (Modern View)
绝对禁止。认为新业务没有历史数据，利润本质上是推测性的 (Speculative)。 允许赔偿。前提是原告能提供充分证据证明损失的金额具有“合理的确定性”。

在本案中，初审法院指示陪审团“法律不允许 (does not permit)”新业务获得利润损失赔偿，这是采用了过时的传统观点。现代法院（以及 MBE 考试标准）认为，只要证据充足（如专家证词、市场数据、类似业务的比较），新业务的利润损失是可以追偿的。

2. 法律推理逻辑

  • 间接损害赔偿 (Consequential Damages)： 利润损失属于间接损害赔偿。根据 Hadley v. Baxendale 规则，这类损失必须是双方在订立合同时 (at the time of contracting) 可以合理预见的。
  • 确定性要求 (Certainty Rule)： 损害赔偿不能基于猜测。原告必须以合理的确定性 (Reasonable Certainty) 证明损失的具体金额。
  • 本案应用： 棒球运动员的经纪人已经作证（且未被反驳），违约导致了其他合同的损失。法院不应直接通过法律指示剥夺陪审团评估这些证据是否“确定”的权利。

3. 为什么其他选项是错误的？

⚠️ 陷阱警示：选项 C
选项 C 看起来很有道理，但它犯了一个致命的法律错误：
它声称预见性的时间点是“违约时 (at the time of the breach)”。

正确规则： 预见性必须是在“订立合同时 (at the time of contracting)” 存在的。这是 MBE 中常见的文字陷阱，请务必小心！
  • 选项 A (Affirmed - Jury Question)： 错误。虽然损害赔偿的金额是陪审团认定的事实问题，但法院给出的法律标准（即完全禁止新业务索赔）是错误的法律指示，这是上诉法院必须纠正的法律错误。
  • 选项 B (Affirmed - Correct Law)： 错误。如上所述，该指示陈述的是旧法，不符合现代通行的法律观点。

4. 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 合同法题目中，如果看到关于利润损失 (Lost Profits) 的选项：

  1. 首先检查是否满足可预见性 (Foreseeability)（时间点：订立合同时）。
  2. 其次检查是否满足确定性 (Certainty)（不能是推测性的）。
  3. 如果涉及“新业务”，不要选择那些说“绝对无法追偿”的选项；选择那些强调“只要能证明确定性即可追偿”的选项。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
An experienced rancher contracted to harvest his neighbor's wheat crop for $1,000 "when the crop [was] ripe." In early September, the neighbor told the rancher that the crop was ripe. The rancher delayed because he had other customers to attend to. The neighbor was concerned that the delay might cause the crop to be lost, for hailstorms were common in that part of the country in the fall. In fact, in early October, before the crop was harvested, it was destroyed by a hailstorm.
Is the rancher liable for the loss?

choices.A: No, because no time for performance was established in the contract.
choices.B: No, because the neighbor failed to tell the rancher that the crop might be destroyed by a hailstorm.
choices.C: Yes, because a party who undertakes a contractual obligation is liable for all the consequences that flow from his breach.
choices.D: Yes, because at the time the contract was made, the rancher had reason to foresee the loss as a probable result of his breach.

questions.explanation:
Consequential damages

Damages for losses stemming from nonbreaching party's special circumstances if breaching party:

  • • knew of those special circumstances
OR
  • • could have reasonably foreseen harm caused by breach

The purpose of compensatory damages is to put the nonbreaching party in the same position as if the contract had been performed as agreed. Compensatory damages include:

  • • expectation damages – the lost value of the breaching party's performance and
  • • consequential damages – losses that arise from the nonbreaching party's special circumstances that were reasonably foreseeable to the breaching party when the contract was made.

Here, the rancher delayed harvesting the neighbor's wheat crop because he had other customers to serve. As a result of the delay, the crop was destroyed by a hailstorm before it could be harvested (special circumstances). This loss was foreseeable when the rancher–neighbor contract was made, given the rancher's experience and the frequency of hailstorms in the fall. Therefore, the rancher is liable for the loss of the crop.

(Choice A) The language in the contract stating that the rancher was to harvest the crop "when the crop was ripe" was sufficient to establish the time of the rancher's performance.

(Choice B) Although the neighbor failed to tell the rancher that the crop might be destroyed by a hailstorm, the rancher's experience and the frequency of hailstorms combined to make the loss foreseeable.

(Choice C) A party who undertakes a contractual obligation is liable only for the foreseeable consequences that flow from his/her breach.

📌 Educational Objective

Consequential damages (ie, losses arising from the nonbreaching party's special circumstances) are recoverable only if they were reasonably foreseeable to the breaching party when the contract was made.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 351 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (unforeseeability and related limitations on damages).
questions.zh-question:
一位经验丰富的牧场主签订合同，为邻居收割小麦作物，报酬为1000美元，合同规定“当作物成熟时”进行收割。九月初，邻居告知牧场主作物已经成熟。牧场主因为需要为其他客户服务而推迟了收割。邻居担心延误可能导致作物损失，因为该地区秋季冰雹很常见。事实上，在十月初，作物在被收割前被一场冰雹摧毁。

牧场主是否应对该损失负责？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为合同中没有确定履行时间。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为邻居未能告知牧场主作物可能会被冰雹摧毁。
zh-choices.C: 是，因为承担合同义务的一方应对其违约所产生的所有后果负责。
zh-choices.D: 是，因为在合同订立时，牧场主有理由预见到该损失是其违约可能导致的结果。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Remedies & Foreseeability
核心考点：间接损害赔偿 (Consequential Damages)

在合同法中，对于因违约造成的间接损失（即非合同直接标的，而是因特殊情况导致的额外损失），只有当该损失在合同订立时对违约方而言是可合理预见 (Reasonably Foreseeable) 的，非违约方才能获得赔偿。

经典判例：Hadley v. Baxendale

📝 案情逻辑链分析

本题考察的是违约方是否需要对“天灾”导致的作物损失负责。逻辑如下：

  1. 违约行为：牧场主 (Rancher) 延迟收割，违反了合同。
  2. 损害结果：作物被冰雹摧毁，价值归零。
  3. 关键连接点（可预见性）：
    • 牧场主是“经验丰富的” (Experienced)。
    • 该地区秋季冰雹“很常见” (Common)。

虽然冰雹是自然灾害，但由于它是该地区该季节的常见风险，且牧场主具备专业经验，因此他在订立合同时应当预见到：如果延迟收割，作物极可能面临被冰雹摧毁的风险。

✅ 正确答案解析 (Option D)

正确 理由： 牧场主有理由预见到损失是其违约的可能结果。

根据 Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 351，如果违约方在订立合同时有理由预见到违约会导致某种特定的损失（本案中为冰雹毁坏作物），则他必须对该间接损害负责。题目特意强调了“经验丰富”和“冰雹常见”，就是为了建立这种客观的可预见性 (Objective Foreseeability)。

❌ 错误选项陷阱

选项 A 错误点： "When ripe"（当成熟时）是一个有效的履行时间条件。合同不需要具体的日历日期才算有效。
选项 B 错误点： 这是一个常见的干扰项。虽然邻居没有明确告知 (Actual Notice)，但法律标准是“有理由预见”。基于牧场主的经验和当地气候常识，他应当知道这个风险，无需邻居特别提醒。
选项 C 错误点： 法律陈述过于绝对。违约方不是对“所有”后果负责，而仅仅是对“可预见”的后果负责。如果发生了一场极其罕见的陨石撞击，牧场主就不需要负责，因为那是不可预见的。
MBE 实战技巧

在处理 Remedies 问题时，如果看到题目中出现描述当事人背景的形容词（如 experienced, expert）或描述环境的词（如 common, frequent），这通常是在暗示可预见性 (Foreseeability) 的存在。

记住公式：
违约 + 特殊情况 + 订立合同时可预见 = 赔偿间接损失

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
On April 1, a carpenter contracted with a homeowner to remodel the homeowner's home for $10,000, the contract price to be paid on completion of the work.
On May 29, relying on his expectation that he would finish the work and have the homeowner's payment on June 1, the carpenter contracted to buy a car under the following terms: "$10,000 in cash, if payment is made on June 1; if payment is made thereafter, the price is $12,000."
The carpenter completed the work according to specifications on June 1 and demanded payment from the homeowner on that date. The homeowner, without any excuse, refused to pay. As a result, the carpenter became very excited, suffered a minor heart attack, and incurred related medical expenses of $4,000. The reasonable value of the carpenter's services in remodeling the homeowner's home was $13,000.
In an action by the carpenter against the homeowner, which of the following should be the carpenter's measure of recovery?

choices.A: $10,000, the contract price.
choices.B: $12,000, the contract price plus $2,000, the bargain that was lost because the carpenter could not pay cash for the car on June 1.
choices.C: $13,000, the amount the homeowner was enriched by the carpenter's services.
choices.D: $14,000, the contract price plus $4,000 for the medical expenses incurred because the homeowner refused to pay.

questions.zh-question:
木匠于6月1日按规格完成了工作，并于当日要求房主付款。房主没有任何理由，拒绝支付。结果，木匠情绪激动，突发轻微心脏病，并产生了4,000美元的相关医疗费用。木匠改造房主房屋服务的合理价值为13,000美元。

在木匠对房主提起的诉讼中，以下哪一项应为木匠的赔偿标准？

zh-choices.A: 10,000美元，即合同价款。
zh-choices.B: 12,000美元，即合同价款加上因木匠未能在6月1日以现金支付车款而损失的2,000美元差价。
zh-choices.C: 13,000美元，即房主因木匠的服务而获得的不当得利。
zh-choices.D: 14,000美元，即合同价款加上因房主拒绝付款而产生的4,000美元医疗费用。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Remedies (合同法：违约救济)

正确答案：A

木匠只能获得 $10,000，即合同约定的价格。

核心考点 1：期待利益 (Expectation Damages)

合同损害赔偿的基本原则是让非违约方处于“假如合同被完全履行”时应处的地位。在本案中，如果房主履行合同，木匠会得到 $10,000。这就是基础赔偿额。

核心考点 2：间接损害 (Consequential Damages)

根据著名判例 Hadley v. Baxendale，间接损失只有在以下情况才能获得赔偿：

  • 在订立合同时，违约方已知晓导致特殊损失的情况；或者
  • 该损失是可合理预见 (Reasonably Foreseeable) 的。

本案应用：房主不知道木匠买车的交易（$2,000 损失），也无法预见拒付会导致心脏病（$4,000 医疗费）。因此，这些损失不可赔偿。

核心考点 3：返还请求权 (Restitution) 的限制

通常，非违约方可以选择“返还请求权”来索取服务的合理价值（$13,000），尤其是当这比合同价更高时。

但是有一个重要例外：

如果原告已经完全履行 (Fully Performed) 了合同义务，且被告剩下的唯一义务是支付金钱，那么原告只能起诉要求合同价款，而不能要求返还服务的市场价值。

选项深度解析
A 正确 $10,000 (合同价)
这是标准的期待利益赔偿。木匠完成了工作，房主欠款 $10,000。
B 错误 $12,000 (包含买车损失)
买车多花的 $2,000 属于间接损失。因为房主在签约时不知道这个购车协议，所以该损失不可预见，无法追偿。
C 错误 $13,000 (服务价值/不当得利)
这是一个经典的 MBE 陷阱。虽然服务价值 $13,000 高于合同价，但因为木匠已经完工，他被锁定在合同价格上，不能通过 Restitution 获得“糟糕交易”的救济。
D 错误 $14,000 (包含医疗费)
商业合同违约通常不赔偿精神痛苦或身体伤害（除非是葬礼合同等极少数情况）。心脏病发作被视为不可预见的后果。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

当你看到题目中提到“服务的合理价值” (Reasonable Value) 高于“合同价格” (Contract Price) 时，警惕以下区分：

  1. 如果非违约方做了一半就因为对方违约停工了 -> 可以选合理价值 (Restitution)。
  2. 如果非违约方已经做完了所有工作 -> 只能选合同价格 (Contract Price)。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A bank agreed to lend a merchant $10,000 for one year at 8% interest. The loan proceeds were to be disbursed within two weeks. The merchant intended to use the loan proceeds to purchase a specific shipment of carpets for resale at an expected profit of $5,000 but said nothing about these plans to the bank.
The bank failed to disburse the proceeds and refused to assure the merchant that it would do so. The merchant was able to secure a loan from another lender at 10% interest for one year. However, by the time the merchant started the application process for a substitute loan, it was too late to pursue the opportunity to buy the shipment of carpets.
In an action against the bank for breach of contract, which of the following amounts is the merchant likely to recover?

choices.A: $5,000, the merchant's foreseeable loss.
choices.B: Nothing, because damages for lost opportunities are not recoverable.
choices.C: Nothing, because the parties failed to tacitly agree that the merchant would be entitled to damages in the event of a breach by the bank.
choices.D: The difference in cost over time between a loan at 10% and a loan at 8%.

questions.zh-question:
一家银行同意以8%的年利率向一位商人贷款10,000美元，为期一年。贷款款项将在两周内发放。该商人打算用这笔贷款购买一批特定的地毯用于转售，预期利润为5,000美元，但未向银行透露这些计划。

银行未能发放贷款，并拒绝向商人保证会这么做。该商人得以从另一家贷款机构获得一笔年利率为10%的一年期贷款。然而，当该商人开始申请替代贷款时，已经来不及寻求购买那批地毯的机会了。

在对银行提起的违约诉讼中，该商人可能获得下列哪项金额的赔偿？

zh-choices.A: 5,000美元，即商人可预见的损失。
zh-choices.B: 无，因为丧失机会的损害赔偿是不可获赔的。
zh-choices.C: 无，因为双方当事人未能默示同意在银行违约的情况下，商人有权获得损害赔偿。
zh-choices.D: 10%利率贷款与8%利率贷款在整个期限内的成本差异。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Remedies
核心考点：期待利益损害赔偿

合同救济的主要目的是将非违约方置于“如同合同已被完全履行”的地位。这被称为期待利益损害赔偿 (Expectation Damages)。

法律规则解析

在借贷合同中，如果贷款人违约（拒绝放款），借款人的标准赔偿计算方式是：

替代贷款的利息成本 - 原合同利息成本

这属于直接损害赔偿 (General Damages)，因为它是违约行为自然且必然导致的后果。

难点辨析：间接损失的可预见性

本题的关键在于区分直接损失和间接损失 (Consequential Damages)。

  • 规则：根据著名的 Hadley v. Baxendale 案规则，间接损失（如利润损失）只有在订立合同时双方都能合理预见的情况下才能获得赔偿。
  • 应用：题目明确指出商人“未向银行透露”购买地毯转售的计划。因此，银行无法预见这 5,000 美元的利润损失。
选项深度解析
✅ 选项 D (正确答案)
商人被迫以 10% 的利率借款，而原合同为 8%。这 2% 的利息差额是商人为了获得资金而产生的额外成本，属于为了“补救” (Cover) 而产生的直接损失，银行必须赔偿。
❌ 选项 A (错误)
虽然 5,000 美元是商人的实际损失，但由于他在签约时保持沉默，这对银行来说是不可预见 (Unforeseeable) 的特殊情况，因此不可获赔。
❌ 选项 B (错误)
说法过于绝对。丧失机会的损失（间接损失）在满足可预见性要求时是可以获赔的，本题不能获赔仅仅是因为银行不知情，而不是因为法律禁止此类赔偿。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

在处理 Remedies 问题时，如果看到原告有“特殊用途”或“巨额预期利润”，立即检查原告是否在签约时告知了被告。

如果题目说原告 "said nothing"（什么也没说），那么这部分特殊利润通常是拿不到赔偿的。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A man and a woman were the parents of an adult son. The son aspired to become a successful music producer but was having difficulty balancing his full-time job with his musical aspirations. As a result, the man and woman agreed in a signed writing that on the last day of January and each succeeding month, each would give the son $3,000 to cover his living expenses and allow him the freedom to pursue his dream. According to the signed writing, the payments to the son were to continue until the son was named "Music Producer of the Year" at a national music awards show.
The man and the woman made the agreed payments in January, February, and March. In April, however, fed up with the son's lack of progress, the man refused to make any payment and notified the woman and the son that he would make no further payments.
Assume that there is a valid contract between the man and woman and that the son has declined to sue the man.
Will the woman succeed in an action against the man in which she asks the court to order the man to continue to make his payments to the son under the terms of the contract?

choices.A: No, because a court will not grant specific performance of a promise to pay money.
choices.B: No, because the man's breach of contract has caused no economic harm to the woman.
choices.C: Yes, because the woman's burden of supporting her son will be increased if the man does not contribute his share.
choices.D: Yes, because the woman's remedy at law is inadequate.

questions.zh-question:
一名男子和一名女子是一个成年儿子的父母。该儿子立志成为一名成功的音乐制作人，但在平衡其全职工作和音乐抱负方面遇到了困难。因此，该男子和女子在一份签署的书面文件中约定，自一月的最后一天起，以及其后每个月的最后一天，他们每人将给儿子3,000美元，以支付其生活费用，并让他能够自由地追求自己的梦想。根据该书面文件，给儿子的付款将持续到儿子在一次全国性音乐颁奖典礼上被评为“年度音乐制作人”为止。

该男子和女子在一月、二月和三月支付了约定的款项。然而，到了四月，男子因对儿子的进展感到厌倦，拒绝支付任何款项，并通知了女子和儿子他将不再进行任何付款。

假设男子和女子之间存在一份有效的合同，并且儿子已拒绝起诉该男子。

如果该女子对该男子提起诉讼，要求法院命令该男子根据合同条款继续向儿子付款，她会胜诉吗？

zh-choices.A: 不会，因为法院不会就金钱支付的承诺作出强制履行裁决。
zh-choices.B: 不会，因为男子的违约行为并未对女子造成经济损害。
zh-choices.C: 会，因为如果男子不支付他应付的份额，女子抚养儿子的负担将会增加。
zh-choices.D: 会，因为该女子的法律救济不充分。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Remedies
正确答案：D 会，因为该女子的法律救济不充分。
(Yes, because the woman's remedy at law is inadequate.)
核心考点：特定履行 (Specific Performance)

在合同法中，法院通常首选金钱赔偿（Money Damages）。只有当金钱赔偿无法充分弥补受害方的损失时，法院才会考虑衡平法救济（Equitable Remedy），即命令违约方履行合同义务。

关键前提：法律救济不充分 (Inadequate Remedy at Law)。

逻辑推演
1
合同性质：这是一个为了第三方（儿子）利益的合同。母亲和父亲交换承诺，目的是给儿子提供资金。
2
普通法救济的局限：如果母亲起诉要求金钱赔偿，她很难证明自己遭受了具体的“经济损失”。
  • 钱是给儿子的，不是给母亲的。
  • 母亲的损失是“期望利益”的落空（即看到儿子获得资助）。
  • 这种损失很难用具体的金钱数额来量化赔偿给母亲。
3
结论：由于金钱赔偿（法律救济）无法实现合同的根本目的，且母亲的损失难以量化，因此满足了“法律救济不充分”这一前提，法院可以判决特定履行。
选项辨析
选项 A 错误： 虽然通常法院不强制执行支付金钱的承诺（因为金钱通常不是独特的），但在本案这种特殊的第三方受益人情形下，简单的金钱判决无法解决问题，因此构成例外。
选项 B 错误： “没有造成经济损害”恰恰是母亲无法获得普通法金钱赔偿的原因，但这正是她有资格寻求衡平法救济（特定履行）的理由，而不是败诉的理由。
选项 C 错误（干扰项）： 虽然“负担增加”听起来很合理，但这描述的是事实后果，而非法律标准。法院判决特定履行的法律依据是“法律救济不充分”，而不是单纯的“负担增加”。在MBE中，必须选择最准确的法律术语。
💡 考试技巧 (Pro Tip)

这道题是MBE中典型的“衡平法门槛”问题。

当你看到原告要求特定履行 (Specific Performance) 时，首先要在大脑中搜索的前提条件就是 "Inadequate Remedy at Law"。

虽然本题在学术上存在争议（如解析中所述，选项C其实体现了衡平法的实质正义），但在标准化考试中，选项D 提供了触发衡平法管辖权的“技术性钥匙”。记住：衡平法是普通法的补充，只有在普通法（金钱赔偿）无能为力时才介入。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A collector bought from a gallery a painting correctly described in the parties' signed contract as a "one-of-a-kind self-portrait" by a famous artist who had recently died. The contract price was $500,000 in cash, payable one month after delivery of the painting by a truck carrier to the collector.
The painting was damaged in transit. The collector timely rejected it after inspection, immediately notified the gallery of the rejection, and told the gallery that the painting would be available for pickup. The gallery then sold the painting to a third party. It informed the collector that it would pick up the painting within a couple of weeks. Two weeks later, before the gallery picked up the painting, the collector sold and delivered the painting to an art admirer for $550,000 cash, after notifying the admirer about the damage. The collector sent no money to the gallery.
If the collector's sale of the painting was NOT an acceptance of the goods, what is the maximum amount that the gallery is entitled to recover from the collector?

choices.A: $50,000 (the excess of the market price over the contract price).
choices.B: $500,000 (the collector-gallery contract price).
choices.C: $550,000 (damages for conversion).
choices.D: Only the allowance of lost profit to the gallery as a volume dealer.

questions.zh-question:
一位收藏家从一家画廊购买了一幅画作，双方签署的合同中正确地将其描述为一位新近去世的著名艺术家的“独一无二的自画像”。合同价格为50万美元现金，在画作由卡车承运人交付给收藏家后一个月内支付。

该画作在运输途中受损。收藏家在检验后及时拒收了画作，并立即通知画廊其拒收决定，告知画廊可以取回画作。画廊随后将该画作出售给第三方。画廊通知收藏家，它将在几周内取回画作。两周后，在画廊取回画作之前，收藏家在告知一位艺术爱好者画作受损情况后，以55万美元现金将画作出售并交付给了该爱好者。收藏家未向画廊支付任何款项。

如果收藏家出售画作的行为不构成对货物的接受，画廊有权向收藏家追讨的最高金额是多少？

zh-choices.A: $50,000（市价超出合同价格的部分）。
zh-choices.B: $500,000（收藏家与画廊的合同价格）。
zh-choices.D: 仅允许画廊作为批量经销商（volume dealer）获得损失利润。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

UCC 买方义务与侵占 (Conversion)

本题考察的核心在于：当买方正当拒收货物后，如果擅自处理（出售）该货物，且该行为不被视为“接受货物”时，卖方可以获得何种救济。

核心法律原则 (UCC § 2-602) 当买方正当拒收 (Rightful Rejection) 货物后，买方有义务合理保管货物，等待卖方取回。买方不得对货物行使任何所有权 (Exercise of Ownership)。

1. 拒收后的法律状态

收藏家（买方）因画作受损正当拒收。此时，画作的所有权和占有权在法律上回归画廊（卖方）。买方仅是该货物的“保管人” (Bailee)。

2. 侵占行为 (Conversion)

题目设置了一个关键前提：“如果收藏家的出售行为不构成对货物的接受”。通常根据 UCC § 2-606，对货物行使所有权会被视为接受。但既然题目排除了这一点，我们必须将该行为视为对他人财产的非法处分。

买方将属于卖方的画作以 $550,000 出售给第三方，这构成了法律上的侵占 (Conversion)。

3. 损害赔偿的计算

在侵占案件中，标准的损害赔偿是侵占发生时货物的公平市场价值 (Fair Market Value at the time of conversion)。

本案中，收藏家成功以 $550,000 将画卖出，这个价格是该画作在当时市场价值的最直接、最有力的证据。因此，画廊有权追讨这 $550,000。

选项辨析

正确 选项 C ($550,000)
这是侵占行为发生时的市场价值。卖方有权获得被侵占财产的全部价值，防止买方因不法行为获利（不当得利）。
错误 选项 A ($50,000)
这仅是差价。如果只赔偿 $50,000，意味着买方保留了 $500,000 的原合同款（假设未付），这不符合侵占赔偿原则。
错误 选项 B ($500,000)
这是原合同价格。如果视为“接受货物”，买方需付合同价。但题目排除了“接受”，且侵占赔偿看重的是实际市价，而非原合同价。
错误 选项 D (损失利润)
“销量损失卖方” (Lost Volume Seller) 规则适用于标准库存商品。本案画作是“独一无二” (One-of-a-kind) 的，卖方无法通过再次销售同类商品来获利，因此不适用此规则。
💡 考试技巧：
注意题目中的假设性条件（如本题的“If... NOT an acceptance”）。MBE 题目有时会通过这种方式强制你进入特定的法律分析路径（本题强制进入 Tort/Conversion 路径），切勿忽略这些限定词而直接套用通常的 UCC 接受规则。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A popular singer expressed interest in performing in a theater producer's musical production. The producer and the singer agreed that there would be no enforceable contractual obligations between them until they had entered into a final, signed contract. Then they began negotiating the terms of the contract.
While the parties were negotiating, the producer began to spend money on the production. When the parties were unable to agree on the terms of a final contract, the producer made reasonable but unsuccessful efforts to hire another singer before abandoning the production.
If the producer sues the singer, what will he likely recover?

choices.A: Expectation damages in the form of the profits that the production would have made if it had been performed.
choices.B: Nothing, because it was not reasonable for the producer to expect to be reimbursed for expenses incurred when he knew that the singer was not obligated until there was a final, signed agreement.
choices.C: Reliance damages in the form of the actual expenses the producer incurred while negotiating with the singer.
choices.D: Restitution for any harm done to the producer's reputation when the production was abandoned.

questions.zh-question:
一位知名歌手表示有兴趣出演某戏剧制作人的音乐剧。制作人与歌手约定，在双方签订最终书面合同之前，彼此之间不存在任何可强制执行的合同义务。随后，他们开始就合同条款进行谈判。

在双方谈判期间，制作人开始为该剧制作投入资金。当双方无法就最终合同条款达成一致时，制作人作出了合理但未成功的努力去聘请另一位歌手，最终放弃了该剧的制作。

如果制作人起诉该歌手，他可能会获得什么赔偿？

zh-choices.A: 预期损害赔偿，即如果该剧成功上演本应获得的利润。
zh-choices.B: 无法获得任何赔偿，因为制作人明知在签订最终书面协议前歌手不受约束，其期望报销所产生的费用是不合理的。
zh-choices.C: 信赖损害赔偿，即制作人在与歌手谈判期间产生的实际费用。
zh-choices.D: 因制作被放弃而对制作人声誉造成的任何损害的不当得利返还。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE Contracts 解析

合同法：缔约过失与信赖利益
正确答案：B

制作人无法获得任何赔偿。因为双方已明确约定在签署最终合同前不承担义务，制作人在此期间产生费用的行为不构成“合理信赖”。

⚖️ 法律逻辑深度解析

本题的核心在于区分合同谈判阶段与合同成立，以及允诺禁反言的适用边界。

1
没有违约 (No Breach of Contract)
双方明确约定："No enforceable contractual obligations... until... final, signed contract"（在签署最终合同前无强制执行力）。
这是一个生效条件（Condition Precedent）。既然最终合同从未签署，合同从未成立，因此不存在违约行为。
2
允诺禁反言不适用 (Promissory Estoppel Fails)
虽然没有合同，通常原告会试图通过 Promissory Estoppel 寻求救济。该原则要求原告必须合理地信赖 (Reasonably Relied) 被告的承诺。

在本案中，由于双方已经明确书面约定“签约前无义务”，制作人明知这一点却仍然在谈判期间花钱，这种行为被法律视为风险自担，不属于“合理”的信赖。
❌ 为什么其他选项错误？
选项 A 错误 预期损害赔偿 (Expectation Damages)
这是违约后的标准赔偿方式，旨在让受害方处于“合同已履行”的状态。既然本案中合同从未成立，自然不存在预期利益赔偿。
选项 C 错误 信赖损害赔偿 (Reliance Damages)
虽然这是允诺禁反言的典型救济方式，但前提是信赖必须是“合理的”。如前所述，无视“签约前无义务”条款而进行的投入是不合理的，因此无法获得赔偿。
选项 D 错误 不当得利返还 (Restitution)
这要求被告（歌手）获得了利益且保留该利益是不公正的。本案中，制作人虽然花了钱，但歌手并没有从中获得任何实质性利益（Unjust Enrichment），因此不适用。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

遇到“谈判破裂”类的题目，请寻找是否有“意图不受法律约束” (Intent not to be bound) 的明确声明。

如果双方明确表示“直到签署文件前都不算数”，那么在此之前的任何支出通常都被视为预备性谈判 (Preliminary Negotiations) 的成本，由各方自行承担，法院极少会介入进行救济。
MBE Contracts Review | QID: Q81828

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A construction firm in a signed writing contracted with a doctor for an agreed price to build a medical office according to specifications provided by the doctor, and to start work on December 1. The construction firm agreed to provide all materials for the job in addition to all of the labor required.
The doctor, without legal excuse, repudiated the contract one week before the construction firm was to start work. Notwithstanding the doctor's repudiation, however, the construction firm subsequently purchased for $50,000 materials that could only be used in building the doctor's medical office, and promptly notified the doctor that it intended to hold him to the contract.
If allowed to perform, the construction firm would have made a profit of $30,000 on the job.
If the doctor refuses to retract his repudiation, and the construction firm sues him for damages, what is the maximum that the construction firm is entitled to recover?

choices.A: $30,000, the construction firm's expectancy damages.
choices.B: $50,000, on a restitutionary theory.
choices.C: $50,000, the construction firm's reliance damages, plus $30,000, its expectancy damages.
choices.D: Nothing, because the construction firm failed to mitigate its damages.

questions.zh-question:
一家建筑公司通过一份书面签署的合同，与一名医生约定以特定价格，根据医生提供的规格建造一间医疗办公室，并于12月1日开工。该建筑公司同意提供工程所需的所有材料以及所有必需的劳动力。

在建筑公司原定开工前一周，该医生无合法理由地拒绝履行合同。然而，尽管医生拒绝履行合同，建筑公司仍随后购买了价值50,000美元且只能用于建造该医生医疗办公室的材料，并立即通知医生其打算坚持要求他履行合同。

如果被允许履行合同，该建筑公司本可从该工程中获利30,000美元。

如果医生拒绝撤回其毁约行为，而建筑公司就损害赔偿起诉他，那么建筑公司有权获得的最高赔偿额是多少？

zh-choices.A: 30,000美元，即建筑公司的期待利益赔偿。
zh-choices.B: 50,000美元，基于返还利益理论。
zh-choices.C: 50,000美元，即建筑公司的信赖利益赔偿，加上30,000美元，即其期待利益赔偿。
zh-choices.D: 无权获得任何赔偿，因为建筑公司未能减轻其损害。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Remedies (合同法：违约救济)
正确答案：A

$30,000，即建筑公司的期待利益赔偿 (Expectancy Damages)。

核心考点：减损义务

在合同法中，当一方违约（包括预期违约 Anticipatory Repudiation）后，非违约方有义务采取合理措施减少损失，这被称为减损义务 (Duty to Mitigate) 或可避免后果原则 (Doctrine of Avoidable Consequences)。

一旦收到违约通知，非违约方不能继续产生费用并期望从违约方那里获得赔偿。

本案时间线分析
时间点 1：医生毁约
医生明确拒绝履行合同 (Repudiation)。此时，建筑公司尚未开工。
时间点 2：公司购买材料 ($50,000)
关键错误：公司在明知医生毁约后，仍然花费 $50,000 购买材料。

法律后果：

  • 可追回：本来可以赚取的利润 ($30,000)。这是为了让非违约方处于“合同如期履行”的地位。
  • 不可追回：毁约后购买的材料费 ($50,000)。因为这是在收到违约通知后产生的不必要开支，属于“未能减损” (Failure to Mitigate)。
建筑合同赔偿计算公式

当业主在施工前违约时：

赔偿额 = 预期利润 + 违约前已发生的合理成本

在本案中：

  • 预期利润 = $30,000
  • 违约前成本 = $0 (尚未开工，材料是违约后买的)
  • 总赔偿 = $30,000
干扰项解析
  • 选项 B (Restitution / 返还利益): 错误。返还利益旨在防止不当得利。由于医生没有收到任何材料或服务，他没有获得任何利益 (Benefit Conferred)，因此无需返还。
  • 选项 C (Reliance + Expectancy): 错误。
    1. 通常不能同时获得信赖利益和期待利益（避免双重赔偿）。
    2. 这里的 $50,000 属于不合理的信赖支出，因为是在对方明确毁约后花费的。
  • 选项 D (No Recovery): 错误。未能减损 (Failure to Mitigate) 只是阻止原告追回那些本可以避免的损失（即那 $50,000 材料费），但不会剥夺其追回预期利润 ($30,000) 的权利。
MBE 考试技巧

看到“Anticipatory Repudiation”（预期违约）和随后的“Expenses”（开销）时，立即警惕：

法院不会奖励“堆积损失” (Piling on damages) 的行为。违约通知一旦发出，非违约方必须停止“流血”（停止花钱）。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A businesswoman sold her business to a company for $25 million in cash pursuant to a written contract signed by both parties. Under the contract, the company agreed to employ the businesswoman for two years as a vice president at a salary of $150,000 per year. After six months, the company, without cause, fired the businesswoman.
Which of the following statements best describes the businesswoman's rights after being fired?

choices.A: She can get specific performance of her right to serve as a vice president of the company for two years.
choices.B: She can recover the promised salary for the remainder of the two years if no comparable job is reasonably available and she does not take another job.
choices.C: She can recover the promised salary for the remainder of the two years if she remains ready to work.
choices.D: She can rescind the contract of sale and get back her business upon tender to the company of $25 million.

一位女商人根据双方签订的书面合同，以2500万美元现金将她的企业出售给一家公司。根据该合同，公司同意聘用该女商人担任副总裁，为期两年，年薪15万美元。六个月后，公司无故解雇了该女商人。

下列哪项陈述最准确地描述了该女商人在被解雇后的权利？

zh-choices.A: 她可以就其担任公司副总裁两年的权利，获得特定履行。
zh-choices.B: 如果没有合理可得的类似工作，并且她没有接受另一份工作，她可以追偿两年剩余期限内承诺的薪水。
zh-choices.C: 如果她保持随时准备工作的状态，她就可以追偿两年剩余期限内承诺的薪水。
zh-choices.D: 她可以在向公司支付2500万美元后，撤销销售合同并收回她的企业。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts & Remedies
雇佣合同违约与救济
🔑 核心法律规则 (Black Letter Law) 当雇主违反雇佣合同时，雇员有权获得预期利益 (Expectation Damages)，即合同剩余期限内的承诺薪水。

⚠️ 但是 (However)：雇员有义务通过寻找类似的 (Comparable) 工作来减损 (Mitigate Damages)。
✅ 正确答案分析 (选项 B)

逻辑推导：

本题中，公司无故解雇女商人构成违约。根据合同法原则，她有权获得剩余1.5年的薪水（$150,000/年）。

然而，法律要求受害方不能坐视损失扩大，必须采取合理措施寻找替代工作。最终的赔偿公式为：

赔偿金 = 承诺薪水 - (实际赚取 + 本可赚取的金额)

选项 B 准确地涵盖了这一规则的两个方面：

  1. 她有权获得承诺的薪水；
  2. 前提条件是：她没有找到类似工作（即无法减损）且没有接受其他工作。

如果市场上确实没有“合理可得的类似工作”，那么她“本可赚取的金额”为零，雇主必须全额赔偿。

❌ 为什么其他选项是错误的？
选项 C (陷阱) “保持随时准备工作” (Ready to work)

这是一个常见的MBE陷阱。旧法（Constructive Service Doctrine）曾允许这种做法，但现代合同法要求积极减损 (Affirmative Duty to Mitigate)。仅仅坐在家里“准备好工作”是不够的，她必须积极寻找替代就业机会。如果她不找工作，法院会扣除她“本可以”找到的工作收入。

选项 A 特定履行 (Specific Performance)

法院几乎从不强制执行个人服务合同 (Personal Service Contracts)。原因包括：

  • 宪法第13修正案（禁止非自愿奴役）；
  • 法院难以监督工作质量和人际关系。

选项 D 撤销合同 (Rescission)

撤销合同通常要求重大违约 (Material Breach) 导致合同目的落空。本案中：

  • 主要交易是2500万美元的企业出售。
  • 雇佣合同只是附属部分。
解雇虽然违约，但相对于2500万的交易而言，不太可能构成“触及合同根本”的重大违约，因此不能撤销整个销售合同，只能就工资损失索赔。

💡 MBE 考试技巧 在处理雇佣合同违约计算赔偿金的题目时，请记住：
Burden of Proof (举证责任) 在于违约方（雇主）。雇主必须证明： 1. 有类似的工作机会存在； 2. 雇员没有尽合理努力去争取。
如果雇主无法证明有类似工作可做，雇员即可获得全额薪水。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A buyer entered into a written contract to purchase from a seller 1,000 sets of specially manufactured ball bearings of a nonstandard dimension for a price of $10 per set. The seller correctly calculated that it would cost $8 to manufacture each set. Delivery was scheduled for 60 days later.
Fifty-five days later, after the seller had completed production of the 1,000 sets, the buyer abandoned the project that required the specially manufactured ball bearings and repudiated the contract with the seller. After notifying the buyer of his intention to resell, the seller sold the 1,000 sets of ball bearings to a salvage company for $2 per set. The seller then sued the buyer for damages.
What damages should the court award to the seller?

choices.A: $2 per set, representing the difference between the cost of manufacture and the price the buyer agreed to pay.
choices.B: $6 per set, representing the difference between the cost of manufacture and the salvage price.
choices.C: $8 per set, representing the lost profits plus the unrecovered cost of manufacture.
choices.D: Nominal damages, because the seller failed to resell the goods by public auction.

questions.explanation:
Seller's damages if market-price differential is inadequate
=
Expected profit
+
Costs reasonably
incurred
-
Proceeds from
resale/mitigation

Under the UCC, the seller can recover damages when the buyer breaches by repudiating the contract or wrongfully refusing to accept the goods. The court will use a measure of damages that puts the seller in the same position as if the contract had been performed, most often based on the market-price differential. But when this measure of damages is inadequate—eg, the contract is for specially manufactured goods of a nonstandard dimension (like the ball bearings here)—the seller's damages are equal to:

  • the profit the seller would have made (eg, $10 per set contract price – $8 per set cost of manufacture = $2 per set) plus
  • an allowance for costs reasonably incurred (eg, $8 per set cost of manufacture) minus
  • payments received for the resale of the goods (eg, $2 per set salvage price).

Therefore, the court should award the seller $8 per set ($2 + $8 – $2), representing the seller's lost profits plus his unrecovered cost of manufacture.

(Choice A) $2 would be a correct measure of damages only if the seller had not yet begun manufacturing the ball bearings. In that case, there would have been no manufacturing costs or need to resell the goods.

(Choice B) The difference between the seller's cost to manufacture the ball bearings and the salvage price (ie, $6) fails to compensate him for lost profits. Therefore, this would not be a proper damages award.

(Choice D) There is no provision in the UCC requiring these goods to be resold by public auction.

📌 Educational Objective

When a buyer breaches by repudiating the contract or wrongfully refusing to accept the goods, the seller is entitled to damages that place it in the same position as if the contract had been performed. For specially manufactured goods, this includes expected profits plus costs reasonably incurred minus any proceeds from reselling the goods.

📚 References
  • U.C.C. § 2-708 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (seller's damages for non-acceptance/repudiation).
questions.zh-question:
一名买方与一名卖方签订书面合同，约定以每套10美元的价格购买1000套非标准尺寸的特制滚珠轴承。

卖方正确计算出每套的制造成本为8美元。交货日期定于60天后。

55天后，在卖方完成了这1000套产品的生产后，买方放弃了需要这种特制滚珠轴承的项目，并向卖方表示拒绝履行合同。在通知买方其转售意图后，卖方以每套2美元的价格将这1000套滚珠轴承出售给了一家旧货公司。随后，卖方向买方提起损害赔偿之诉。

法院应判给卖方多少损害赔偿金？

zh-choices.A: 每套2美元，即制造成本与买方同意支付价格之间的差额。
zh-choices.B: 每套6美元，即制造成本与残值售价之间的差额。
zh-choices.C: 每套8美元，即可得利润加上未收回的制造成本。
zh-choices.D: 象征性损害赔偿，因为卖方未能通过公开拍卖方式转售货物。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析：
特制商品的违约赔偿

Subject: Contracts / Remedies
正确答案与核心规则

本题的正确答案是 选项 C。

核心考点：根据美国统一商法典 (UCC)，当买方违约时，卖方有权获得预期利益损害赔偿 (Expectation Damages)，即让卖方处于“如同合同被完整履行”时的经济地位。

对于特制商品 (Specially Manufactured Goods)，由于缺乏标准市场价格，赔偿计算公式通常为：

赔偿金 = 预期利润 + 发生的成本 - 转售所得
逻辑推演与计算

让我们拆解本题的数字逻辑：

1. 预期利润 (Expected Profit)
合同价 $10 - 成本 $8 = $2
这是卖方如果交易成功本应赚到的钱。
2. 已发生成本 (Costs Incurred)
卖方已经完成了制造，投入了 $8。
这是卖方的实际支出（信赖利益）。
3. 转售所得/减损 (Resale/Mitigation)
卖方将废品卖给旧货公司回收了 $2。
这部分钱必须从赔偿中扣除，否则卖方会获得双重收益。
计算过程：
$2 (利润) + $8 (成本) - $2 (回收) = $8

另一种理解方式：
卖方实际损失了 $6 的本金（$8 成本 - $2 回收），加上他本该赚到的 $2 利润。总共需要赔偿 $8。

为什么其他选项是错的？
  • 选项 A ($2) 错误：
    这仅仅是利润。如果卖方尚未开始生产就得知买方违约，那么他没有投入成本，只赔 $2 是对的。但这里卖方已经投入了成本。
  • 选项 B ($6) 错误：
    这是“未收回的成本” ($8 - $2)。这只补偿了卖方的本金损失，却忽略了卖方本应获得的利润。合同法不仅保护本金，还保护预期的利润。
  • 选项 D (象征性赔偿) 错误：
    UCC 并不强制要求必须通过“公开拍卖” (Public Auction) 来转售货物。只要转售是商业上合理的 (Commercially Reasonable) 即可。
🎓 MBE 抢分技巧：

看到 "Specially Manufactured"（特制/定制）商品时，立即警惕：

  1. 通常没有标准的市场价格 (Market Price)，所以不能用简单的 "合同价 - 市场价" 公式。
  2. 适用 UCC § 2-708(2)：赔偿核心是 利润 (Profit)。
  3. 如果货物已经制成，必须加上成本并减去残值。

简单记忆法：
如果是定制品且无法转卖给他人（或只能当废品卖），直接用：
合同价 ($10) - 转售残值 ($2) = 赔偿金 ($8)
*前提是转售行为合理。

A.text: difference between the cost of manufacture and the price the buyer agreed to pay

B.text: difference between the cost of manufacture and the salvage price

D.text: resell the goods by public auction

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
By the terms of a written contract signed by both parties on January 15, an electronics store agreed to sell a specific personal computer to a college student for $3,000, and the college student agreed to pick up and pay for the computer at the store on February 1. The college student unjustifiably repudiated on February 1. Without notifying the college student, the electronics store subsequently sold at private sale the same specific computer to another customer, who paid the same price ($3,000) in cash. The personal computer at issue is a popular product. The electronics store can buy from the manufacturer more units than it can sell at retail.
If the electronics store sues the college student for breach of contract, what will the electronics store probably recover?

choices.A: $3,000 (the contract price), because the college student intentionally breached the contract by repudiation.
choices.B: Nothing, because the electronics store failed to give the college student proper notice of its intention to resell.
choices.C: Nothing, because the electronics store received a price on resale equal to the contract price that the college student had agreed to pay.
choices.D: The electronics store's anticipated profit on the sale to the college student plus incidental damages, if any, because the electronics store lost that sale.

questions.explanation:
UCC seller's damages
(from buyer's nonacceptance or repudiation)
Default rule =
Contract price
−
Market or resale price
+
Incidental damages
Lost-volume seller =
Lost profit
+
Incidental damages
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

When a buyer repudiates (ie, refuses to perform) a contract for the sale of goods, the seller's remedies include compensatory damages for the seller's actual losses. If the seller chooses to resell the goods, then the standard measure of damages is the difference between the contract price and the resale price plus incidental damages. But this measure of damages is inadequate when the seller is a lost-volume seller—ie:

  • has a practically inexhaustible inventory of the type of goods in question (eg, electronics store can buy more personal computers of the kind at issue than it can sell at retail) and
  • but for the breach, would have made two sales (and two profits) rather than one (eg, personal computer at issue is a popular product).

In such cases, the seller is entitled to the lost profit from the original sale plus incidental damages arising from the breach (eg, storage or shipping costs). Therefore, the electronics store can recover the anticipated profit on the sale to the college student plus incidental damages, if any, because it lost that sale (Choice C).

(Choice A) The fact that the college student intentionally breached the contract by repudiation does not entitle the electronics store to the full contract price. But had the store been unable to resell the computer after making reasonable efforts to do so at a reasonable price, then it may have been able to recover the $3,000 contract price.

(Choice B) A seller must reasonably notify the buyer of its intention to resell goods at a private sale only if the seller seeks to recover the standard measure of damages. But here, the store would seek its lost profit from the breach since the standard measure would yield no damages ($3,000 contract price - $3,000 resale price = $0).

📌 Educational Objective

When a seller has a practically inexhaustible inventory of the goods and but for a buyer's breach would have made two sales and two profits rather than one (ie, lost-volume seller), the seller is entitled to lost profit from the original sale plus incidental damages.

📚 References
  • U.C.C. § 2-708 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (seller's damages for nonacceptance or repudiation).
questions.zh-question:
根据双方于1月15日签订的一份书面合同的条款，一家电子产品商店同意以3000美元的价格向一名大学生出售一台特定的个人电脑，该大学生也同意于2月1日到店自提并支付电脑款项。该大学生于2月1日无理地毁约。在未通知该大学生的情况下，该电子产品商店随后通过私下出售的方式，将同一台特定的电脑卖给了另一位顾客，该顾客以现金支付了相同的价格（3000美元）。涉案的个人电脑是一款热门产品。该电子产品商店可以从制造商处购买的电脑数量，多于其在零售端可以售出的数量。

如果该电子产品商店因违约起诉该大学生，该商店可能会获得何种赔偿？

zh-choices.A: 3000美元（合同价格），因为该大学生通过毁约的方式故意违反了合同。
zh-choices.B: 无法获得任何赔偿，因为电子产品商店未能就其转售意图向该大学生发出适当的通知。
zh-choices.C: 无法获得任何赔偿，因为电子产品商店在转售中收到的价格，与该大学生同意支付的合同价格相等。
zh-choices.D: 电子产品商店向该大学生销售本可获得的预期利润，加上附带损害赔偿（如有），因为该商店损失了那笔销售。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Remedies
✅ 正确答案：选项 D
预期利润 (Anticipated Profit) + 附带损害 (Incidental Damages)
🔑 核心概念：销量损失卖方
Lost Volume Seller

这是 UCC Article 2 中关于违约救济的一个经典例外规则。当卖方拥有无限供应能力时，标准的“合同价与转售价之差”无法弥补其损失。

法律依据与推理 (Analysis)

本题适用的法律是美国统一商法典 (UCC) 第 2 篇。

1. 标准规则的失效：
通常情况下，买方违约时，卖方的赔偿金计算公式为：
合同价格 - 转售价格 = 损害赔偿
在本题中，合同价是 $3,000，转售价也是 $3,000。如果套用此公式，赔偿金为 $0。但这显然不公平。

2. 识别“销量损失卖方”：
题目给出了两个关键事实：

  • 涉案电脑是热门产品 (Popular product)。
  • 商店能买到的电脑数量多于其能卖出的数量 (Unlimited supply)。
这意味着，商店卖给第二位顾客的那台电脑，并不是为了“填补”第一位大学生的空缺。如果大学生没有违约，商店本可以同时卖出两台电脑，赚取两份利润。

3. 适用 UCC § 2-708(2)：
因为大学生的违约，商店实际上少做了一笔生意（Lost Volume）。因此，法律允许卖方索赔“若合同履行本可获得的利润” (Lost Profit)，加上附带损害赔偿 (Incidental Damages)。

为什么其他选项是错的？
❌ 选项 A (合同全价)：
只有当货物无法转售 (unable to resell) 时，卖方才能根据 UCC § 2-709 要求支付全额价款 (Action for the price)。本题中电脑已成功转售，故不适用。
❌ 选项 B (通知问题)：
虽然 UCC § 2-706 要求转售需通知买方，但这仅适用于卖方想索赔“差价”的情况。既然这里索赔的是“利润损失”，通知与否不是决定性因素。
❌ 选项 C (无赔偿)：
这是最强的干扰项。它机械地套用了“合同价 - 转售价”公式，忽略了卖方是 Lost Volume Seller 的特殊身份。
💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 合同法题目中，如果看到卖方是零售商 (Retailer)、制造商 (Manufacturer) 或拥有大量库存 (Inventory)，且题目提到“unlimited supply”或“can produce more than it can sell”，请立即警惕 Lost Volume Seller 考点！

此时答案通常是 Lost Profit，而不是差价。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A landscaper agreed to maintain the yard of a homeowner for six months for a fee of $300 per month, payable at the end of the six-month period. This amount was the fair market value of the work to be performed. The landscaper performed the work for four months but was then offered another job for $500 per month and, after notifying the homeowner, stopped doing the promised work and took the other job.
The homeowner refused to pay the landscaper anything. The homeowner could have hired a comparable landscaper to complete the work for $300 per month.
In a lawsuit between the landscaper and the homeowner, what is the likely result?

choices.A: Neither the landscaper nor the homeowner will recover, because neither has suffered any loss.
choices.B: The homeowner will recover $400, which constitutes the unjust enrichment of the landscaper.
choices.C: The homeowner will recover $600, which is the cost of completing the work at prevailing market rates.
choices.D: The landscaper will recover $1,200 for the work done before the breach.

questions.explanation:
Restitutionary damages
Definition
  • Damages awarded to restore to claimant the value of whatever benefit was conferred upon recipient
Purpose
  • Prevent unjust enrichment
Measure
  • Reasonable value of work performed or services rendered (ie, cost of recipient obtaining comparable performance)
  • If applicable, extent to which recipient's property has increased in value or recipient's other interests have been advanced

A breaching party who incurs loss may not sue for compensatory damages for the party's actual losses. However, if the breaching party has significantly performed, he/she may recover restitutionary damages from the nonbreaching party for the reasonable value of the work performed.* This ensures that the nonbreaching party is not unjustly enriched. The reasonable value of the work performed is typically measured by the cost of obtaining comparable performance.

Here, the landscaper breached the parties' agreement after maintaining the homeowner's yard for four out of the agreed-upon six months. The landscaper had significantly performed two-thirds of the contract, so the landscaper is entitled to restitution for the reasonable value of the work done before the breach. And since a comparable landscaper could have done the work for $300 per month, the landscaper will recover $1,200 ($300 per month x 4 months) (Choice A).

*The breaching party's restitutionary recovery is limited to the contract price, reduced by any damages that the nonbreaching party incurred as a result of the breach and could not reasonably avoid.

(Choice B) The homeowner (not the landscaper) was unjustly enriched because the homeowner received lawn-maintenance services for four months but paid nothing. The fact that the landscaper will receive an additional $400 (($500-300) per month x 2 months) from a different job has no bearing on the outcome of this dispute.

(Choice C) As the nonbreaching party, the homeowner could recover expectation damages, measured by the difference between the contract price and the cost of completing the work at prevailing market rates. But the contract and market prices are the same here ($300 per month), so the homeowner will recover nothing.

📌 Educational Objective

A breaching party who has significantly performed may recover restitutionary damages from the nonbreaching party for the reasonable value of the work performed, as measured by the cost of obtaining comparable performance.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 371 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (measure of restitution interest).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 374 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (restitution in favor of breaching party).
questions.zh-question:
一位园艺师同意为一名房主维护庭院，为期六个月，每月费用为300美元，在六个月期满时支付。该金额是待完成工作的公平市场价值。园艺师工作了四个月，但随后获得了另一份月薪500美元的工作，并在通知房主后，停止了承诺的工作，接受了另一份工作。

房主拒绝向园艺师支付任何费用。房主本可以以每月300美元的价格聘请一位类似的园艺师来完成剩余的工作。

在园艺师与房主之间的诉讼中，可能的结果是什么？

zh-choices.A: 园艺师和房主均无法获得赔偿，因为双方均未遭受任何损失。
zh-choices.B: 房主将获得400美元的赔偿，这构成了园艺师的不当得利。
zh-choices.C: 房主将获得600美元的赔偿，这是按现行市场价格完成工作的成本。
zh-choices.D: 园艺师将因违约前完成的工作获得1200美元的赔偿。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Restitution for Breaching Party

⚖️ 核心法律规则

即使是违约方 (Breaching Party)，如果已经进行了实质性履行，也有权要求返还性损害赔偿 (Restitutionary Damages)，以防止非违约方获得不当得利 (Unjust Enrichment)。

参考来源: Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 374

本题考察的是当一方违约时，如何计算其已完成工作的价值。很多考生会误以为“违约者不得拿钱”，这是旧普通法的观点，现代合同法规则如下：

1计算已履行的价值

园艺师工作了4个月，每月市场价值$300。

收益价值 (Benefit Conferred):
$300 × 4 = $1,200

2计算非违约方的损失

房主需要找人做剩下的2个月工作。题目明确指出，房主可以以同样的价格 ($300/月) 雇佣替代者。

这意味着房主没有因为违约遭受额外经济损失。

抵扣额 (Offset/Damages): $0

返还金额 = 已履行价值 - 房主损失
$1,200 = $1,200 - $0

因此，正确答案是 D。园艺师有权拿回他已完成工作的公平市场价值。

✅ 为什么选 D (Correct)

根据现代合同法原则（Restitution），为了避免房主白白享受了4个月的服务而不付钱（不当得利），房主必须支付这部分服务的合理价值。由于房主没有遭受额外损失，不需要从这笔钱中扣除赔偿。

❌ 为什么 A 错误

选项A反映了严苛的旧普通法规则（Strict Rule），即违约方无权获得任何赔偿。但在MBE考试适用的现代规则下，只要避免了不当得利，违约方仍可获偿。

❌ 为什么 B 错误

选项B关注的是园艺师从新工作中获得的“额外收益”($200/月)。这是无关项。合同法关注的是双方在本合同中的损益，园艺师在其他地方赚多少钱与房主对本合同的支付义务无关。

❌ 为什么 C 错误

选项C是计算房主的预期利益 (Expectation Damages)。只有当房主为了完成工作不得不支付比原合同更高的价格时（例如每月$400），房主才能索赔。这里市场价持平，房主无损失。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧：
遇到“服务合同中途违约”的题目：
  1. 首先确认违约方是否做了事（有价值）。
  2. 计算该工作的合理市场价值（通常等于合同按比例价格）。
  3. 关键一步：检查非违约方找人接盘是否花了更多钱。
  4. 如果有额外花费，从违约方的报酬中扣除；如果没有，违约方拿走全部已做工作的价值。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
An employer offered to pay a terminated employee $50,000 to release all claims the employee might have against the employer. The employee orally accepted the offer. The employer then prepared an unsigned release agreement and sent it to the employee for him to sign. The employee carefully prepared, signed, and sent to the employer a substitute release agreement that was identical to the original except that it excluded from the release any age discrimination claims. The employer signed the substitute release without reading it. Shortly thereafter, the employee notified the employer that he intended to sue the employer for age discrimination.
Is the employer likely to prevail in an action seeking reformation of the release to conform to the parties' oral agreement?

choices.A: No, because the employer acted unreasonably by failing to read the substitute release prior to signing it.
choices.B: No, because the parol evidence rule will preclude evidence of the oral agreement.
choices.C: Yes, because the employee's fraudulent behavior induced the employer's unilateral mistake.
choices.D: Yes, because the parties were mutually mistaken regarding the contents of the signed release.

questions.explanation:
Availability of reformation as a remedy
Misrepresentation
  • One party makes untrue assertion of fact that is fraudulent or material
  • Adversely affected party justifiably relies on that misrepresentation
Mutual mistake
  • Both parties are mistaken as to contract's contents or legal effect
Unilateral mistake
(from fraudulent misrepresentation)
  • One party is mistaken because other party intentionally misrepresented contract's content or legal effect
  • Adversely affected party justifiably relies on that misrepresentation

Reformation is an equitable remedy courts can use to rewrite a contract to reflect the parties' original intent. This remedy is always available when misrepresentation or mutual mistake occurs. But a unilateral mistake only serves as a basis for reformation if that mistake stemmed from fraudulent misrepresentation, which occurs when:

  • one party intentionally misrepresents the content or legal effect of a contract to induce the other party to enter into the contract and
  • the other party justifiably relies* on that misrepresentation.

Here, the employer reduced the parties' oral agreement to writing and sent the unsigned release to the employee. The employee then carefully prepared, signed, and sent to the employer a substitute release that omitted age discrimination claims (intentional misrepresentation). Because the substitute release was otherwise identical to the original, the employer did not notice the omission and signed the release (justifiable reliance). And since the employee's fraudulent behavior caused the employer's unilateral mistake, the court will likely reform the release to reflect the parties' oral agreement (Choice D).

*This element is always met unless the misrepresentation was patently and obviously false.

(Choice A) The employer may have acted unreasonably by failing to read the substitute release prior to signing it. But a party's negligence in failing to read a writing does not preclude reformation if the writing does not accurately reflect the parties' prior agreement.

(Choice B) The parol evidence rule generally precludes extrinsic evidence of a prior oral or written agreement to modify or contradict the unambiguous terms of a final written agreement. But such evidence is excepted from this rule and is always admissible when it is used to establish a ground for granting or denying a contractual remedy like reformation (as seen here).

📌 Educational Objective

A court can reform a contract to reflect the parties' original intent when one party's fraudulent misrepresentation caused the other party's unilateral mistake.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 166 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (reformation based on fraudulent misrepresentation).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 172 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (definition of justifiable reliance).
questions.zh-question:
某雇主提出向一名被解雇的员工支付 50,000 美元，以了结该员工可能对雇主提出的所有索赔。该员工口头接受了该提议。随后，雇主准备了一份未签署的免责协议，并将其发送给该员工签署。该员工精心准备、签署并向雇主发送了一份替代免责协议，该协议除排除了任何年龄歧视索赔外，与原协议完全相同。雇主未阅读该替代免责协议就签署了。此后不久，该员工通知雇主，他打算以年龄歧视为由起诉雇主。

在寻求对免责协议进行修正（reformation）以使其符合双方口头协议的诉讼中，雇主是否可能胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为雇主在签署替代免责协议前未予阅读，其行为不合理。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为口头证据规则（parol evidence rule）将排除有关口头协议的证据。
zh-choices.C: 是，因为员工的欺诈行为导致了雇主的单方错误（unilateral mistake）。
zh-choices.D: 是，因为双方对已签署的免责协议内容存在共同错误（mutual mistake）。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Reformation & Mistake

✅ 正确答案：C

雇主可以胜诉。因为员工的欺诈性虚假陈述 (Fraudulent Misrepresentation) 导致了雇主的单方错误 (Unilateral Mistake)。

核心考点：合同修正 (Reformation)

Reformation 是一种衡平法救济 (Equitable Remedy)，法院通过它修改书面合同，使其反映双方真实的口头协议。

通常适用 Reformation 的两种情况：

类型 定义 本案适用性
共同错误
(Mutual Mistake)		 双方都搞错了（通常是笔误）。 ❌ 不适用
员工很清楚自己在改什么。
单方错误 + 欺诈
(Unilateral Mistake + Fraud)		 一方搞错，另一方故意误导或隐瞒。 ✅ 适用
员工偷偷替换了文件。
本案逻辑链条
1
口头达成一致：
支付$50k，放弃所有索赔。
2
员工的欺诈行为：
偷偷制作了一份看起来一样，但排除了“年龄歧视”索赔的替代协议。
3
雇主的单方错误：
以为这是原件，未阅读直接签署。
4
法律后果：
因欺诈导致的单方错误，法院允许修正合同以符合口头约定。
为什么“没读合同”不是抗辩理由？

这是本题最大的干扰项（选项 A）。

通常原则是 "Duty to Read"（阅读义务），即你签了字就要负责。

例外： 当一方通过欺诈 (Fraud) 诱导另一方签署时，欺诈者不能用受害者的“疏忽”作为挡箭牌。法律优先惩罚欺诈者，而不是惩罚疏忽者。

选项 A 错误： 虽然雇主没读合同是疏忽，但在面对员工的故意欺诈时，这种疏忽不阻碍 Reformation。
其他干扰项解析
选项 B (Parol Evidence Rule) 错误：
PER 口头证据规则禁止用口头证据改变书面合同。但有一个著名的例外：当证据用于证明欺诈 (Fraud) 或 错误 (Mistake) 以寻求 Reformation 时，PER 不适用。
选项 D (Mutual Mistake) 错误：
共同错误要求双方都不知道文件有误。这里员工是“精心准备”的替代文件，他完全知情，所以不是 Mutual Mistake。
💡 MBE 考试技巧：
看到“一方偷偷修改了书面草案” (Surreptitious substitution) + “另一方没看就签了”的情节：
  1. 定性为 Fraud / Misrepresentation。
  2. 救济方式是 Reformation（改回原来的约定）。
  3. 不要被“Failure to read”或“Parol Evidence Rule”吓退，欺诈是这些规则的克星。

reason.en: Incorrectly applies the parol evidence rule, overlooking its exception for reformation claims.
reason.zh: 错误地应用了口头证据规则，忽视了其在合同重构请求中的例外情况。

reason.en: Identifies the correct legal basis for reformation when induced by fraud.
reason.zh: 确定了因欺诈引起的合同重构的正确法律依据。

reason.en: Incorrectly frames the issue as mutual mistake when only one party was mistaken.
reason.zh: 在仅有一方存在错误的情况下，错误地将问题界定为共同错误。

highlights.text: The employee orally accepted the offer.

reason.en: Establishes the meeting of minds that serves as the baseline for reformation.
reason.zh: 确立了作为合同重构基准的双方意思表示一致。

highlights.text: a substitute release agreement that was identical to the original except that it excluded from the release any age discrimination claims

reason.en: Indicates the employee's intentional misrepresentation of the contract terms.
reason.zh: 表明雇员对合同条款的有意识虚假陈述。

highlights.text: The employer signed the substitute release without reading it.

reason.en: Shows the employer's unilateral mistake and justifiable reliance on the appearance of the document.

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question: An art collector paid a gallery $1,000 to purchase a framed drawing from the gallery's collection. The price included shipping by the gallery to the collector's home. The gallery's owner used inadequate materials to wrap the drawing. The frame broke during shipment and scratched the drawing, reducing the drawing's value to $300. The collector complained to the gallery owner, who told the collector to take the drawing to a specific art restorer to have the drawing repaired. The collector paid the restorer $400 to repair the drawing, but not all of the scratches could be fixed. The drawing, after being repaired, was worth $700. The gallery owner subsequently refused to pay either for the repairs or for the damage to the drawing. In an action by the collector against the gallery owner for damages, which of the following awards is most likely?

choices.A: Nothing.

questions.explanation:
UCC effect of repair costs on buyer's recovery
Effect of buyer's repairs
Buyer's recovery
Seller breaches by damaging goods
Restores goods to warranted value
Paid repair costs
Does not restore goods to warranted value
Paid repair costs +
(warranted − post-repair value)
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

Under the UCC, contracts for the sale of goods come with an implied warranty of merchantability if the seller is a merchant with respect to the type of goods involved. Under this warranty, damage caused by the seller's failure to adequately package an item constitutes a breach. If the buyer nevertheless chooses to accept the goods, the buyer's damages are the difference between:

  • the value of the goods as accepted and
  • the value of the goods as warranted.

Repair costs are often used to determine this difference in value. But if the repairs fail to restore the goods to their value as warranted, the buyer can recover the repair costs plus the difference between the value of the goods as warranted and the value of the goods after the repairs.*

Here, the gallery's use of inadequate materials to wrap the drawing constituted a breach of warranty. The resulting damage during shipment reduced the drawing's value to $300. And although the art collector paid the restorer $400 to repair the drawing, it was worth just $700 after the repairs. As a result, the collector can recover the repair costs ($400) plus the difference between the drawing's value after the repairs and its value as warranted ($1,000 - $700 = $300). Therefore, an award of $700 is most likely (Choices A, B & C).

*This assumes that the buyer paid for the repairs.

📌 Educational Objective

When repairs fail to restore goods to their value as warranted, the buyer's damages are equal to the cost of repairs plus the difference between the value of the goods after the repairs and the value of the goods as warranted.

📚 References
  • U.C.C. § 2-314 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (implied warranty of merchantability).
  • U.C.C. § 2-714 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (buyer's damages for breach in regard to accepted goods).
questions.zh-question: 一位艺术收藏家向一家画廊支付了1000美元，从该画廊的藏品中购买一幅带框的画作。价格包含由画廊运送至收藏家家中的费用。画廊所有者使用了不当的材料来包装这幅画作。在运输过程中，画框破损并刮伤了画作，使其价值降至300美元。收藏家向画廊所有者投诉，所有者告知收藏家将画作带到一位特定的艺术品修复师那里进行修复。收藏家支付了400美元给修复师修复画作，但并非所有划痕都能被修复。修复后的画作价值700美元。随后，画廊所有者拒绝支付修复费用或赔偿画作的损失。在收藏家对画廊所有者提起的损害赔偿诉讼中，下列哪项判决金额最有可能？

zh-choices.A: 无。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析：违约救济

UCC 核心法律规则

本题考察的是《统一商法典》（UCC）下，买方接受了有瑕疵货物（Accepted Goods）后的损害赔偿计算方法。

根据 UCC § 2-714，当货物不符合合同约定（例如违反了默示担保 Implied Warranty of Merchantability）时，买方的标准赔偿金计算公式为：

赔偿金 = 承诺价值 (Value Warranted) - 实际价值 (Value Accepted)

此外，买方还可以追偿附带损害（Incidental Damages）和间接损害（Consequential Damages）。

Analysis 案情逻辑推演

1. 确定违约：
画廊作为商人，包装不当导致画作损坏，违反了合同及默示担保。

2. 确定基准价值：
如果画作完好（即承诺价值），价值为 $1,000。

3. 确定损失计算路径：
本题中，买方试图通过修复（Repair）来减少损失（Mitigation）。计算赔偿有两种等效的逻辑，结果一致：

  • 逻辑 A（直接价值差）：
    画作损坏后的即时价值为 $300。
    赔偿 = $1,000 - $300 = $700。

  • 逻辑 B（修复成本 + 剩余贬值）：
    这是本题更具体的计算方式。修复未能完全恢复原状。
    赔偿 = 修复费用 + (承诺价值 - 修复后价值)

Math 详细计算步骤

为什么答案是 $700 (选项 D)？请看以下算式：

1. 实际支付的修复费：   $400
2. 剩余价值贬损：     +$300
($1,000 原价 - $700 现价)
总赔偿金额：         =$700

法律原理： 目标是让买方处于“如同合同被完全履行”的状态（Expectation Interest）。

买方本来应该拥有一幅价值 $1,000 的画。现在他手里有一幅价值 $700 的画，并且为了修画额外花掉了 $400。为了让他回到拥有 $1,000 价值的状态，卖方必须赔偿 $700。

Tips 考试技巧

  • 识别考点： 看到货物损坏、修复失败、价值贬损，立即联想 UCC § 2-714。
  • 不要被中间数字迷惑：
    • 选项 B ($300) 是损坏后的残值，不是赔偿额。
    • 选项 C ($400) 仅是修复费。如果修复后画作恢复到了 $1,000，那么赔偿 $400 是对的。但因为还有永久性贬值，仅赔修复费是不够的。
  • 核心原则： 问自己“给买方多少钱，加上他手里的东西，等于他原本应得的价值？”
MBE Contracts / Remedies Review

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A lumber mill contracted with a trucking company to transport lumber from the mill to a residential contractor. The trucking company promised the mill that the lumber would arrive at the location specified in the contract on August 1. However, the contract contained a clause providing that the trucking company would not be liable for any losses suffered by the mill as a result of a late shipment. The trucking company was aware that the mill had contracted with the contractor to deliver the lumber on August 1, and that the price to be paid by the contractor decreased for each day that the lumber was late. The shipment of lumber did not reach the contractor until August 10, and the trucking company had no justification for the delay. Because of the delay, the mill lost revenue from the sale in excess of the cost to transport the lumber to the contractor. The mill filed suit against the trucking company for breach of contract, claiming damages based on its lost revenue.
Is the mill likely to succeed in its claim for these damages?

choices.A: No, because the claimed damages exceeded the original contract price between the trucking company and mill to transport the lumber.
choices.B: No, because the contract between the mill and the trucking company protected the company from losses suffered by the mill due to a late shipment.
choices.C: Yes, because consequential damages cannot be excluded by a merchant.
choices.D: Yes, because the damages that the mill would suffer from the trucking company's delay were known to the company before shipment of the lumber.

questions.explanation:
Consequential damages

Damages for losses stemming from nonbreaching party's special circumstances if breaching party:

  • • knew of those special circumstances
OR
  • • could have reasonably foreseen harm caused by breach

The primary goal of contract damages is to put the nonbreaching party in the same position it would have been in had the contract been fully performed. This includes recovering consequential damages for losses arising from the nonbreaching party's special circumstances if the breaching party:

  • • knew about those circumstances or
  • • could have reasonably foreseen the harm that would result from a breach.

However, contracting parties are free to set their own terms, so they can agree to limit or exclude the recovery of consequential damages (unless the limitation or exclusion is unconscionable).

Here, the trucking company agreed to deliver the lumber from the mill to the contractor. The trucking company knew that the mill entered into a contract with the contractor to deliver the lumber on August 1 and that the mill would suffer damages if the delivery was delayed. Nevertheless, the lumber was not delivered until August 10 (Choice D). But because the contract included a clause that the trucking company would not be liable for losses suffered by the mill as a result of a late shipment, the mill is unlikely to succeed in its claim for damages.

(Choice A) The lack of proportionality between the contract price and the amount of consequential damages may be an underlying factor in determining whether such damages are foreseeable. But proportionality alone is not determinative regarding foreseeability. In any case, the parties may generally allocate responsibility for consequential damages as they see fit.

(Choice C) The UCC prohibits the limitation or exclusion of liability for consequential damages, but only if the limitation or exclusion is unconscionable. A commercial loss (e.g., lost revenue) is not prima facie unconscionable. Additionally, the UCC applies only to contracts for the sale of goods (not this service contract).

📌 Educational Objective

Parties to a contract are free to set their own terms—including limiting or excluding the recovery of consequential damages.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 351, Reporter's Note to cmt. a (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (discussing enforceability of agreements to exclude or limit consequential damages).
questions.zh-question:
主题：合同法（Contracts）— 救济（Remedies）

题目：
一家 lumber mill（木材厂）与一家 trucking company（卡车运输公司）订立合同，由该公司将木材从木材厂运送给一位 residential contractor（住宅承包商）。运输公司向木材厂承诺，木材将在合同指定地点于8月1日送达。然而，合同中包含一项条款，规定对于因迟延发货而使木材厂遭受的任何损失，运输公司不承担责任。运输公司知道木材厂已经与该承包商签订合同，约定于8月1日交付木材，并且承包商应支付的价款会因木材迟延送达的每一天而减少。木材直到8月10日才送达承包商处，而且运输公司的迟延没有任何正当理由。由于这次迟延，木材厂因该笔销售而损失的收入，超过了将木材运送给承包商的成本。木材厂以 breach of contract（违约）为由起诉运输公司，主张基于其 lost revenue（损失收入）的 damages（损害赔偿）。

木材厂是否有可能在该项损害赔偿请求中胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 不能，因为所主张的损害赔偿超过了木材厂与运输公司之间原始运输合同的价款。
zh-choices.B: 不能，因为木材厂与运输公司之间的合同使该公司免于承担因迟延发货而使木材厂遭受的损失。
zh-choices.C: 可以，因为 consequential damages（间接损害赔偿）不能被 merchant（商人）排除。
zh-choices.D: 可以，因为运输公司在木材发货前已经知道，如果其迟延，木材厂将遭受该等损害。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Liquidated Damages & Limitation of Remedies
正确答案：原告（木材厂）无法就其损失的利润获得赔偿，因为双方合同中包含有效的责任免除条款，该条款免除了被告因延迟出货而导致原告遭受损失的赔偿责任。

核心法律原则

间接损失与责任限制条款

在合同法中，违约救济的首要目标是使非违约方处于合同被完全履行时其本应处于的经济地位。这包括在特定情况下收回间接损失（consequential damages）。然而，合同自由原则允许当事人自行分配风险：

  • 间接损失的默认索赔条件： 违约方在订立合同时，必须已经知悉非违约方的特殊情况，或者能够合理预见违约将导致该特殊损害（即满足可预见性规则 Hadley v. Baxendale）。
  • 责任限制与免除条款（Limitation/Exclusion of Liability）： 尽管默认规则允许索赔可预见的间接损失，但合同双方完全有权在合同中约定限制或完全免除间接损失的赔偿责任。只要该条款不构成显失公平（unconscionable），法院就会予以执行。

法律体系对比：普通法 vs. UCC 买卖合同法

对比维度 普通法 (Common Law) UCC 货物买卖法 (UCC Article 2)
适用对象 服务合同（如本案的运输服务）、建筑合同、房地产交易。 有形动产（Goods）的买卖。
间接损失免除条款的效力 商业合同中，免除间接损失的条款普遍有效，除非证明存在欺诈、胁迫或极端的显失公平。 同样允许限制或免除，但若限制人身伤害的赔偿则被推定为显失公平（Prima Facie Unconscionable）。
商业损失（如利润损失） 商业主体之间自愿分配风险，法院极少干预，条款高度有效。 在商业买卖中，免除商业损失（如营业额、利润损失）不被推定为显失公平。

案情适用与推导逻辑

1 识别合同性质： 本案中，木材厂与卡车运输公司签订的是“运输木材”的合同。运输属于服务（Services），因此本案受普通法（Common Law）管辖，而非 UCC。
2 分析默认规则下的可预见性： 卡车运输公司在签约时非常清楚，木材厂必须在 8 月 1 日前交货，且延迟交货会导致木材厂被扣减款项。因此，延迟交货导致的利润损失（间接损失）在签约时是完全可预见的。
3 适用合同特约条款： 尽管上述损失满足可预见性，但双方在合同中明确约定：“卡车运输公司不对木材厂因延迟出货而遭受的任何损失承担责任”。
4 得出结论： 这是一个典型的商业合同风险分配。由于该免责条款在商业背景下不构成显失公平，因此该条款完全有效，直接阻断了木材厂索赔间接损失的权利。
合同义务与免责条款效力链条
木材厂 (Mill)
➔ 签订运输合同 (含免责条款) ➔
运输公司 (Trucking Co.)
虽然运输公司知悉延迟会导致木材厂对第三方违约（满足可预见性），
但合同中的“免除延迟损失责任”条款具有最高效力，阻断了间接损失的索赔。
⚠️ MBE 常见陷阱提示：
  • “可预见性”并非绝对通行证： 许多考生在看到“运输公司在签约前就知悉延迟会导致木材厂损失”时，会兴奋地直接选择允许索赔的选项（如 Choice D）。请记住：合同明示条款（Express Terms）的效力高于法律默认规则（Default Rules）。一旦双方通过合同排除了某项权利，默认的可预见性规则便不再适用。
  • UCC 规则的误用： 考生容易混淆 UCC 中关于“显失公平”的限制，误以为所有限制间接损失的条款都无效。事实上，即使在 UCC 下，商业主体之间免除商业利润损失也是完全合法的。

正确答案与干扰项排除

B. 正确

因为木材厂与运输公司之间的合同条款明确保护了运输公司，免除其因延迟出货而给木材厂带来的损失赔偿责任。在商业合同中，双方当事人有权通过合同条款自由分配风险、限制救济方式，该条款合法有效，木材厂无法胜诉。

A. 错误

该选项认为“索赔的损失超过了原运输合同的价格，所以不能索赔”。这在法律上是不正确的。虽然合同价格与索赔金额之间的比例失衡是评估损失是否“可预见”的一个考量因素，但它本身并不是否定间接损失索赔的决定性法定事由。本案无法索赔的根本原因在于合同中存在明确的免责条款。

C. 错误

该选项认为“商家（Merchant）之间不能免除间接损失”。这存在双重错误：第一，本案是运输服务合同，适用普通法而非 UCC；第二，即使适用 UCC，UCC 也仅在涉及“人身伤害（Personal Injury）”时才推定免责条款显失公平，在商业损失（如本案的利润损失）中，商家之间免除间接损失是完全允许且非常普遍的。

D. 错误

该选项认为“因为运输公司在出货前就知道延迟会带来损失，所以木材厂可以胜诉”。这属于典型的“只看默认规则，忽视合同特约”的陷阱。虽然运输公司的确知悉该特殊情况（满足了 Hadley v. Baxendale 的可预见性要求），但合同中的免责条款已经自愿放弃了这一索赔权利。特约条款优于默认规则。

💡 考试必背金句：
在做合同法救济（Remedies）题目时，永远先看合同里有没有限制救济或免除责任的条款（Limitation of Liability / Liquidated Damages）。如果有，先评估该条款的效力（商业合同中基本都有效）；只有在合同没有约定的情况下，才去套用法律的默认救济规则（如 Foreseeability, Mitigation 等）。

keywords.text: would not be liable for any losses

reason.en: An express agreement between the parties to exclude liability for consequential damages.
reason.zh: 双方约定免除因迟延交货而产生损失赔偿责任的明示条款。

keywords.text: was aware that the mill had contracted

reason.zh: 表明损失具有可预见性，通常情况下允许主张间接损失赔偿。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A man who knew nothing about horses inherited a thoroughbred colt whose disagreeable behavior made him a pest around the barn. The man sold the horse for $1,500 to a buyer who was an experienced racehorse-trainer and knew of the man's ignorance about horses. At the time of sale, the man said to the buyer, "I hate to say it, but this horse is bad-tempered and nothing special."
Which one of the following scenarios would best support an action by the buyer to rescind the sale?

choices.A: A week after the sale, the horse went berserk and inflicted injuries upon the buyer that required his hospitalization for six months and a full year for his recovery.
choices.B: After the horse had won three races for the buyer, it was discovered that by clerical error, unknown to either party, the horse's official birth registration listed an undistinguished racehorse as the sire rather than the famous racehorse that in fact was the sire.
choices.C: In his first race after the sale, the horse galloped to a huge lead but dropped dead 100 yards from the finish line because of a rare congenital heart defect that was undiscoverable except by autopsy.
choices.D: The horse won $5 million for the buyer over a three-year racing career but upon being retired was found to be incurably sterile and useless as a breeder.

questions.zh-question:
一个对马一无所知的男子继承了一匹纯种小马，这匹马脾气不好，在马厩里是个麻烦精。该男子以1500美元的价格将马卖给了一位买家，这位买家是一位经验丰富的赛马训练师，并且知道该男子对马一无所知。在出售时，该男子对买家说：“我不想这么说，但这匹马脾气不好，没什么特别之处。”

下列哪种情况最能支持买家提起诉讼以撤销该交易？

zh-choices.A: 交易一周后，该马匹发狂并致使买家受伤，买家因此需要住院六个月，并用一整年时间进行康复。
zh-choices.B: 在该马匹为买家赢得三场比赛后，人们发现，由于双方都不知晓的一处文书错误，该马匹的官方出生登记将其父亲列为一匹无名赛马，而非其实际上的父亲——一匹著名赛马。
zh-choices.C: 在交易后的第一场比赛中，该马匹曾一度遥遥领先，但在距离终点线100码处因一种罕见的先天性心脏缺陷而猝死，该缺陷除非通过尸检否则无法发现。
zh-choices.D: 在三年的赛马生涯中，该马匹为买家赢得了500万美元奖金，但在退役时被发现患有不治之症的不育症，作为种马毫无价值。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE Contracts / Remedies

共同错误与合同撤销

本题考查的核心法律原则是基于共同错误的合同撤销 (Rescission based on Mutual Mistake)。

⚖️ 法律规则 (Black Letter Law)

当双方当事人在订立合同时对同一事实存在错误认识（共同错误），受不利影响的一方可以撤销合同，但必须同时满足以下三个条件：

  • 错误涉及合同的基本假定 (Basic assumption)。
  • 错误对约定的交换具有重大影响 (Material effect)。
  • 寻求撤销的一方未承担该错误的风险 (Did not bear the risk of the mistake)。
✅ 正确答案：选项 C

情境：马匹在交易后第一场比赛中因罕见的先天性心脏缺陷猝死，该缺陷除非尸检无法发现。

解析：

  1. 基本假定：买卖双方在交易时都认为这匹马是活的、健康的生物。这是合同成立的基础。
  2. 重大影响：马匹因先天缺陷死亡，价值归零，导致“对价完全落空” (Total failure of consideration)。
  3. 风险承担：这是本题的关键。虽然买家是专家，通常需承担质量风险，但题目强调该缺陷是“除尸检外无法发现的” (Undiscoverable except by autopsy)。这意味着这是一种隐蔽瑕疵 (Latent defect)，即使是专家也无法通过常规检查发现。因此，买家并未承担这种特定错误的风险。

为什么其他选项不支持撤销？

❌ 选项 A (一周后发狂)：
这是合同订立之后发生的事件。撤销权的行使必须基于合同订立时 (At the time of contract) 已经存在的事实错误。后续的性格变化属于风险转移后的问题，而非“错误”。
❌ 选项 B (血统更好)：
虽然这也是一个共同错误，但这个错误使马匹更有价值。撤销权仅赋予受不利影响 (Adversely affected) 的一方。买家获利了，因此无权撤销。
❌ 选项 D (赚了500万后不育)：
买家花费$1,500赚取了500万美元，该错误并未对买家造成重大不利影响 (Material adverse effect)。此外，购买赛马本身就包含其退役后可能无法繁殖的商业风险。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 在处理“错误” (Mistake) 类题目时，请按以下步骤思考：
  1. 时间点： 错误的事实是否在签约当时就已经存在？（排除选项 A）
  2. 方向： 错误是否让想毁约的那个人吃亏了？（排除选项 B）
  3. 程度： 吃亏的程度是否严重动摇了合同基础？（排除选项 D）
  4. 风险： 吃亏的人是否理应知道这个风险？（本题中“无法发现”排除了风险承担）。

question_analysis.skill_tested: Assess grounds for contract rescission

reason.en: Identifies the specific legal remedy sought by the buyer.
reason.zh: 确定买方所寻求的特定法律救济。

reason.en: Establishes that the seller had no specialized knowledge or superior expertise.
reason.zh: 确立了卖方不具备专业知识或更优越的技能。

reason.en: Indicates the buyer's professional status, relevant to risk assumption.
reason.zh: 表明买方的专业身份，与风险分配及承担相关。

reason.en: Distracts with severe personal injury damages, which are irrelevant to the contract remedy of rescission.
reason.zh: 用严重的人身伤害赔偿进行干扰，这与合同解除救济无关。

reason.en: A mistake that actually benefits the buyer does not satisfy the requirement of being adversely affected.
reason.zh: 对买方实际上有利的误解不满足受不利影响这一要件。

reason.en: An undiscoverable condition at the time of sale that goes to a basic assumption of the contract.
reason.zh: 交易时无法发现的状况，涉及合同的基本假设。

reason.en: Defect discovered after three years of successful performance and profit, bar to rescission.
reason.zh: 在成功履行并获利三年后发现的缺陷，阻碍了合同解除的适用。

highlights.text: rescind the sale

reason.en: Identifies that the buyer is seeking rescission based on mutual mistake.
reason.zh: 明确买方正基于双边误解寻求合同解除。

highlights.text: knew of the man's ignorance about horses

reason.en: Shows the buyer knew the seller could not have known about the horse's internal health or pedigree defect.
reason.zh: 表明买方明知卖方不可能了解马匹的内部健康或血统缺陷。

reason.en: Reflects an opinion and quality disclaimer, which shifts general quality risk but not basic viability risk.
reason.zh: 反映了意见表述与品质免责，这转移了普通的质量风险，但未转移基本生存能力的风险。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A produce distributor contracted to provide a grocer with eight crates of lettuce at the distributor's listed price. The distributor's shipping clerk mistakenly shipped only seven crates to the grocer. The grocer accepted delivery of the seven crates but immediately notified the distributor that the delivery did not conform to the contract. The distributor's listed price for seven crates of lettuce was 7/8 of its listed price for eight crates. The distributor shipped no more lettuce to the grocer, and the grocer has not yet paid for any of the lettuce.
How much, if anything, is the distributor entitled to collect from the grocer?

choices.A: Nothing, because the tender of all eight crates was a condition precedent to the grocer's duty to pay.
choices.B: The listed price for the seven crates of lettuce.
choices.C: The listed price for the seven crates of lettuce, minus the grocer's damages, if any, for the distributor's failure to deliver the full order.
choices.D: The reasonable value of the seven crates of lettuce, minus the grocer's damages, if any, for the distributor's failure to deliver the full order.

questions.zh-question:
一家农产品分销商签约，按其标价向一家杂货商提供八箱生菜。该分销商的发货员错误地只向杂货商运送了七箱。杂货商接受了这七箱货物的交付，但立即通知分销商，该交付不符合合同规定。分销商对七箱生菜的标价是其八箱生菜标价的7/8。分销商没有再向杂货商运送生菜，而杂货商也尚未支付任何生菜的款项。

分销商有权向杂货商收取多少款项（如有）？

zh-choices.A: 无权收取任何款项，因为交付全部八箱货物是杂货商付款义务的先决条件。
zh-choices.B: 七箱生菜的标价。
zh-choices.C: 七箱生菜的标价，减去因分销商未能完全交付订单而给杂货商造成的损失（如有）。
zh-choices.D: 七箱生菜的合理价值，减去因分销商未能完全交付订单而给杂货商造成的损失（如有）。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Remedies
核心考点：UCC 违约救济

本题考察《统一商法典》（UCC）第二篇关于货物买卖中买方接受不符合同货物后的付款义务与损害赔偿抵扣权。

逻辑推演 (Analysis)

1 适用法律：UCC
生菜（Lettuce）属于可移动的有形物品，即货物（Goods）。因此，本案适用 UCC 而非普通法（Common Law）。
2 完全履行规则 (Perfect Tender Rule)
根据 UCC § 2-601，卖方交付的货物必须完全符合合同要求。分销商只运送了7箱而非8箱，构成了违约（Breach）。买方有权拒收（Reject）或接受（Accept）。
3 接受货物后的义务 (Effect of Acceptance)
题目指出杂货商“接受了这七箱货物的交付”（Accepted delivery）。
根据 UCC § 2-607(1)，买方必须按合同费率（Contract Rate）支付已接受货物的价款。
"The buyer must pay at the contract rate for any goods accepted."
4 抵扣损害赔偿 (Deduction of Damages)
虽然买方必须付款，但根据 UCC § 2-717，买方在通知卖方违约意图后，可以从应付价款中扣除因违约导致的任何损害赔偿。
"The buyer on notifying the seller of his intention to do so may deduct all or any part of the damages resulting from any breach of the contract from any part of the price still due under the same contract."
结论：
分销商有权收取 7 箱生菜的合同价格（而非合理价值），但必须减去杂货商因缺货造成的损失。因此，选项 C 是正确答案。

易错项辨析

为什么不选 D (Reasonable Value)？
“合理价值”通常用于准合同（Quasi-contract）或合同价格未定的情况。本案中双方有明确的合同价格，UCC 规定按“合同费率”支付，而非市场合理价值。
为什么不选 A (Condition Precedent)？
虽然完全履行是买方有义务接受的先决条件，但一旦买方主动选择接受了货物，付款义务即产生。接受行为豁免了将“全部交付”作为付款条件的抗辩。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧

看到货物买卖 (Sale of Goods)，立即联想 UCC。

当买方接受 (Accepts) 了有瑕疵的货物：
  1. 买方必须付款（按合同价，非市场价）。
  2. 买方可以扣除损失（Set-off）。
记住公式：
应付金额 = (已收货物 × 合同单价) - 违约损失

question_analysis.skill_tested: calculating seller recovery after buyer acceptance

reason.en: Establishes the existence of a binding agreement between the parties.
reason.zh: 确立双方之间存在具有约束力的协议。

reason.en: Constitutes a breach of the perfect tender rule by the seller.
reason.zh: 构成卖方违反完美交付规则的行为。

reason.en: Triggers the buyer's obligation to pay at the contract rate under the UCC.
reason.zh: 触发买方在UCC下按合同价格付款的义务。

reason.en: Preserves the buyer's right to seek damages for the nonconforming delivery.
reason.zh: 保留买方因非违约交付而索赔的权利。

reason.en: Indicates that the seller's action is for the price of the accepted goods.
reason.zh: 表明卖方的诉求是要求支付已接受货物的价款。

reason.en: Misapplies the perfect tender rule to bar any recovery after acceptance.
reason.zh: 错误地将完美交付视为接受货物后付款的绝对先决条件。

reason.en: Fails to account for the buyer's right to deduct damages for breach.
reason.zh: 未能考虑买方扣除违约损失的权利。

reason.en: Correctly applies UCC 2-717 allowing the buyer to deduct damages from the price.
reason.zh: 正确适用UCC 2-717，允许买方从价款中扣除损失。

reason.en: Incorrectly uses quasi-contractual recovery instead of the contract rate for accepted goods.
reason.zh: 错误地使用准合同恢复，而非针对已接受货物的合同价格。

highlights.text: accepted delivery of the seven crates

reason.en: Under UCC 2-607, acceptance obligates the buyer to pay the contract rate for those goods.
reason.zh: 根据UCC 2-607，接受货物使买方有义务为该货物支付合同价。

highlights.text: immediately notified the distributor that the delivery did not conform to the contract

reason.en: Timely notice is required under UCC 2-607(3)(a) to preserve breach remedies including damages.
reason.zh: 根据UCC 2-607(3)(a)，必须及时通知以保留包括损失赔偿在内的违约救济。

highlights.text: mistakenly shipped only seven crates

reason.en: Establishes that the seller breached the contract by failing to deliver the full quantity.
reason.zh: 确立卖方因未能交付全部数量而违反合同。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A seller and a farmer formed a written, signed contract for the sale of a 500-acre tract of farmland. The contract provided for exchange of the deed for $500,000 in cash on January 15. On January 15, the seller notified the farmer that because the tenant currently residing on the farmland wrongfully refused to quit the premises, the seller could not deliver possession until January 30. On January 30, the farmer accepted the conveyance, paid the $500,000, and took possession of the farmland while reserving his rights to any damages caused by the seller's breach.
The farmer had purchased 500 head of cattle to be delivered to the farmland on January 15. Because he did not have possession of the farmland on that date, he had to rent another pasture for $2,000 to graze the cattle for 15 days. The seller had no reason to know the farmer purchased cattle or planned to graze them on the farmland. Throughout January, the farmland's market value was $510,000 and its fair monthly rental value was $5,000.
In an action by the farmer against the seller for damages, what is the farmer entitled to recover?

choices.A: $2,500 only (the fair rental value of the farmland for 15 days).
choices.B: $2,500 (the fair rental value of the farmland for 15 days), plus $2,000 (the cost of grazing the cattle elsewhere for 15 days).
choices.C: Nominal damages only, because the market value of the land exceeded the contract price.
choices.D: Nothing, because by paying the purchase price on January 30, he waived whatever cause of action he may have had.

questions.explanation:
Alternative bases for recovery when loss in value uncertain
Delayed use of property
  • Fair rental value of property during period of delay
OR
  • Interest on value of property made unproductive by breach
Defective or unfinished construction
  • Diminution in market price of property caused by breach
OR
  • Reasonable cost of completing performance or remedying defects

A nonbreaching party's recovery is typically based on the loss in value to that party caused by the breach. But if the loss in value cannot be proved with reasonable certainty and there is a reasonable alternative to loss in value, the nonbreaching party may claim damages based on that alternative. For example, if a breach delays the use of property, the nonbreaching party may recover damages based on:

  • the fair rental value of the property during the period of the delay or
  • interest on the value of the property that has been made unproductive by the breach.

Here, the seller breached the land-sale contract by failing to deliver possession of the farmland on January 15 as agreed. On January 30, the farmer accepted the conveyance, paid the purchase price, and took possession of the farmland while reserving his right to sue for any damages caused by the seller's breach (Choice D). As a result, the farmer is entitled to recover $2,500—the fair rental value of the farmland for the 15-day period during which he was denied possession.

However, the farmer is not entitled to recover $2,000 for the cost of grazing the cattle elsewhere for 15 days (Choice B). The reason is that consequential damages arising from the nonbreaching party's special circumstances are only recoverable if the breaching party (1) knew about the special circumstances or (2) could have reasonably foreseen the harm, in light of those circumstances, that would result from the breach. Here, the seller had no reason to know that the farmer had purchased cattle or planned to graze them on the farmland.

(Choice C) The fact that the market value of the farmland ($510,000) exceeded the contract price ($500,000) does not limit the farmer's recovery to nominal damages only.

📌 Educational Objective

If a breach delays the use of property, the nonbreaching party may recover damages based on (1) the fair rental value of the property during the delay period or (2) interest on the value of the property made unproductive by the breach.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 348 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (alternatives to loss in value of performance).
questions.zh-question:
一名卖方和一名农场主签订了一份书面合同，出售一块500英亩的农田。合同规定，于1月15日以500,000美元现金交换地契。1月15日，卖方通知农场主，由于目前居住在农田上的租户无理拒绝搬离，卖方要到1月30日才能交付占有权。1月30日，农场主接受了产权转让，支付了500,000美元，并占有了该农田，同时保留了就卖方违约造成的任何损害索赔的权利。

该农场主购买了500头牛，原定于1月15日运至该农田。由于当日他未能占有该农田，他不得不另租一处牧场15天，花费2,000美元来放牧这些牛。卖方没有理由知道农场主购买了牛或计划在该农田上放牧。整个1月份，该农田的市场价值为510,000美元，其公平月租金价值为5,000美元。

在农场主对卖方提起的损害赔偿诉讼中，农场主有权获得多少赔偿？

zh-choices.A: 仅2,500美元（该农田15天的公平租金价值）。
zh-choices.B: 2,500美元（该农田15天的公平租金价值），加上2,000美元（在别处放牧牛15天的费用）。
zh-choices.C: 仅象征性损害赔偿，因为土地的市场价值超过了合同价格。
zh-choices.D: 无权获得任何赔偿，因为他在1月30日支付了购买价款，从而放弃了他可能拥有的任何诉因。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Remedies (合同法：违约救济)
正确答案：A

农场主有权获得 $2,500（15天的公平租金价值），但无权获得额外的 $2,000 放牧费用。

核心考点分析
考点 1 延迟交付的一般损害赔偿 (General Damages)

当卖方违反合同延迟交付不动产占有权时，买方的标准赔偿是延迟期间财产的使用价值损失。

计算方法
通常以该财产在延迟期间的公平租金价值 (Fair Rental Value) 来衡量。

本案应用：
农田月租金为 $5,000。延迟时间为半个月（1月15日至1月30日）。
$5,000 × 0.5 = $2,500。这是买方肯定可以获得的赔偿。

考点 2 后果性损害赔偿 (Consequential Damages)

买方额外花费的 $2,000 租用其他牧场属于后果性损害（或称特殊损害）。

Hadley v. Baxendale 规则
后果性损害只有在违约方在订立合同时能够合理预见 (Reasonably Foreseeable) 的情况下才可以获得赔偿。

本案应用：
题目明确指出：“卖方没有理由知道 (had no reason to know) 农场主购买了牛或计划在该农田上放牧”。
因此，这笔费用是不可预见的，卖方无需赔偿。

为什么其他选项是错的？
❌ 选项 B ($2,500 + $2,000)
错误原因：如上所述，$2,000 的放牧费属于不可预见的后果性损害，不予赔偿。
❌ 选项 C (仅象征性赔偿)
错误原因：虽然土地升值了（市场价 $510k > 合同价 $500k），但这不影响买方因延迟占有而遭受的实际使用损失（租金价值）。市场价差价通常用于计算“完全不履行”时的赔偿，而非“延迟履行”。
❌ 选项 D (无赔偿/弃权)
错误原因：买方接受迟延交付并支付价款，并不意味着放弃索赔。题目明确说明买方保留了权利 (reserved his rights)。在普通法和 UCC（类推适用）下，接受不完美的履行并保留权利，依然可以就违约造成的损失索赔。
🎓 MBE 答题技巧

看到“特殊损失”（如本题中的牛群安置费、利润损失等），立即寻找题目中关于“知情/预见性”的描述。

  • 如果卖方不知道特殊情况 ➡️ 不赔 (General Damages only)。
  • 如果卖方知道特殊情况 ➡️ 要赔 (General + Consequential)。
